fields.description: Belgrove Residences is an Ellington apartment development in the Meydan area, with one-, two- and three-bedroom homes. Property Finder describes a pool, gym, landscaped gardens and family spaces. Historical Belgrove-branded documents remain available, although its previously linked developer page now redirects to a differently named project.

overview: The historical brief lists 210 homes: 137 one-bedroom, 33 two-bedroom, 33 two-bedroom-plus-study and seven three-bedroom.
research.locationNote: The historical brief places Belgrove in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Property Finder now groups the project under Meydan Horizon.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 1,685,828, rounded to AED 1.7m in its headline, and marks developer stock sold out. Current pricing is unverified.
research.paymentNote: The historical reference is 20% booking, 50% during construction and 30% completion. Confirm the unit’s current signed terms and project identity.
research.handoverNote: The historical Belgrove brief targets Q3 2027; Property Finder gives September 2027. Actual completion remains unverified.
